avoid_supplements.name: High-dose chromium
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate insulin effect and increase hypoglycemia risk by enhancing insulin sensitivity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation or use only under medical supervision with increased glucose monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (Korean/Siberian)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Can lower blood glucose levels and may potentiate insulin effect, increasing hypoglycemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor blood glucose closely with frequent self-monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: Fenugreek seeds
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Contains compounds that slow carbohydrate absorption and enhance insulin sensitivity, synergistic hypoglycemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; counsel on hypoglycemia symptoms and glucose monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-lipoic acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modestly improve insulin sensitivity and reduce insulin requirements
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose more frequently; may require insulin dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Cinnamon
caution_supplements.mechanism: Some evidence suggests modest effects on glucose metabolism and insulin sensitivity
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for changes in glycemic control; minimal risk at typical dietary doses

avoid_foods.name: High glycemic index refined carbohydrates (white bread, sugary drinks)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Rapid glucose absorption may cause postprandial hyperglycemia spikes despite insulin aspart's rapid onset, increasing glycemic variability
avoid_foods.action: Counsel on carbohydrate quality and consistent meal timing relative to insulin administration

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay gastric emptying and slow carbohydrate absorption, potentially delaying peak glucose rise relative to insulin aspart peak action
caution_foods.action: Monitor for delayed postprandial glucose elevation; may require timing adjustment of insulin injection

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (especially without food)
caution_foods.mechanism: Can impair hepatic glucose production and increase hypoglycemia risk, particularly when combined with insulin
caution_foods.action: Advise limiting alcohol consumption and always consuming with carbohydrate-containing food

monitoring_notes: Insulin aspart is not significantly metabolized by CYP enzymes, so drug-drug interactions are primarily pharmacodynamic. Close glucose monitoring is essential as supplements or foods affecting carbohydrate absorption or insulin sensitivity can significantly impact glycemic control and hypoglycemia risk.
